Eugnosta misella has a wingspan of 9–11 mm. I fetched the Wikipedia article directly, and it states "The wingspan is 9–11 mm," citing Aarvik (2010) on East African Cochylini. Neither of the ranges in the team note (20–24 mm or 14–16 mm) appears in that source, and the Earth.com entry the search cited also gives 9–11 mm, per the search summary, though I did not open that page myself.

CONFIDENCE: 85
